title: Privacy and usage measurement
text: Me-LON measures how its library is used to help improve learning resources. Collection starts when this analytics system is published; earlier reading activity is not available.

title: Privacy and usage measurement
text:
What we measure
We collect book opens, page or chapter changes, broad device categories and estimated engaged reading time. A random browser identifier helps estimate daily readers and avoid counting reloads as new sessions. It does not identify a verified student. Returning visitors can be counted again on another day, device or browser.
Reading time counts only while a page is visible, focused and recently active. It pauses after 90 seconds without activity and is capped at six hours per book session per day. These figures estimate engagement; they do not establish attendance, completion or examination performance.

title: Privacy and usage measurement
text:
Storage and access
Usage data are stored in Google Firebase / Firestore in the DRONA project, in Mumbai. The reporting dashboard is restricted to verified administrator accounts. We do not include names, email addresses, passwords or raw IP addresses in the analytics records. Google Cloud may process request metadata in its infrastructure logs. Short-lived deduplication and rate-limit records expire after approximately 45 days; aggregated daily counts are retained for reporting.

title: Privacy and usage measurement
text:
Your choice
Me-LON respects your browser’s Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control settings. You can also disable measurement for this browser below. Your choice is saved locally and does not affect access to books.

title: A little help to get started
text:

title: A little help to get started
text:
Studying R
Start with the foundations in R Programming for Agricultural Data Analysis. Read the explanation, inspect the example and try changing one thing at a time. Browser laboratories need an internet connection and may take a moment to load. A laptop is useful for longer coding sessions; your phone is useful for reading and revision.

title: A little help to get started
text:
Make reading comfortable

Turn your phone sideways when a wide table or code example needs more room.
Use your browser’s text-size or zoom settings to make the text comfortable.
Save chapter bookmarks rather than relying on an open tab.
Online books need a connection. Download a practical only when the book provides a download link.

title: A little help to get started
text:
Course notes and passcodes
The books linked in this library are open to read. If your teacher shares a separate course resource with a passcode, use the link and code supplied by that teacher.

title: A little help to get started
text:
Something not working?
Contact the department with the book name, chapter and a short description of the problem. Include your browser and phone model if possible.

title: STAT MAASH
text:
A MOOC ON Me-LONYour companion for learning, practice and progress.Coming Soon
STAT MAASH stands for Mentor AI for Academic Success and Help. It is being introduced on Me-LON as a MOOC, bringing guided online learning and practical activities into one place.
The planned learning experience combines step-by-step lessons, interactive R practice, self-assessment and AI-assisted guidance. Students will be able to work through topics at their own pace, try examples and check their understanding as they progress.
Details about courses, access and enrolment will be shared here when STAT MAASH is ready to launch on Me-LON.

title: Learning, shared freely
text:
Me-LON is an online learning initiative for students of Kerala Agricultural University, developed by Dr. Pratheesh P. Gopinath and maintained by the Department of Agricultural Statistics, College of Agriculture, Vellayani.
Me-LON is designed for learning across subjects and departments. The library currently includes statistics and R books, and will grow to include textbooks, lecture notes and practical resources in other subjects as they are contributed.
Our aim is simple: make educational resources easy to find and comfortable to read across phones, tablets and computers.

title: Learning, shared freely
text:
For teachers
Teachers from all subjects and departments are welcome to contribute. To share lecture notes or other educational content, contact the maintainer with your course name and material. Word documents can be converted into online reading resources; practical materials can include downloadable files where appropriate. Access arrangements depend on the resource and should be agreed with the department.
